summary: Solowin Holdings filed a Form 6-K disclosing a November 5, 2026 securities purchase agreement under which Gemini Asia Holdings Limited, beneficially owned by Chairman/CEO Ling Ngai Lok, will subscribe for 1,000,000 Class B ordinary shares at US$1.20 per share for US$1,200,000 gross. The price is roughly 70% of the November 4, 2026 Class A close of US$1.71. Proceeds fund working capital. The audit committee and disinterested directors approved; Lok recused. Each Class B share carries 50 votes, lifting Lok to about 95.17% voting power. Closing is expected on or around November 20, 2026.
